record.name: TealKit: Private AI Agents
record.offering: Productivity app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
The Zero-Config Alternative  to OpenClaw
TealKit turns your phone into a versatile AI powerhouse with autonomous agents and built-in tools. Provider-independent, fully customizable, and designed for privacy.

AI Playground & Flexibility
Use leading providers (Google Gemini, OpenAI GPT-5, Anthropic, Mistral) or local Ollama models. Provider-independent, customize model parameters fully, and keep token costs predictable. Try out ideas in the chat interface before creating new agents.

Built-in AI Skills for Everyday Tasks
- Email & Calendar: Google integration (Gmail, Drive, Calendar) alongside universal IMAP/SMTP support. Search and send emails, or create calendar entries. (Microsoft OneDrive coming next).
- Document Intelligence: Index local documents on your phone (or any folder on Desktop) into local DuckDB. Perform semantic searches across all document types (Word, PDF, etc.).
- Content Creation: Generate files (TXT, PDF, Excel), create diagrams from any data source, and visualize flows with Mermaid.
- Web Search & Indexing: Crawl and index websites (scheduled auto-reindex coming soon) for quick semantic searches. Perform web searches via Serpdev, SerpApi, or DuckDuckGo.
- Remote Management: SSH remoting and shell script generation to automate server monitoring and tasks. Generate PowerShell or Bash scripts on desktop, controlled by the app.

Limitless Extensibility — Add Any Skill
- Query and register cloud-based MCP servers (e.g., from Smithery).
- One-click import to use prebuilt MCP servers from GitHub.
- Add custom AI skills directly on your phone using sandboxed JavaScript.
- Create Python MCP servers on desktop (Node.js coming later).

Agentic Workflows & Automation
- Run agents manually with any tool combination — local file output included.
- Schedule cron-based recurring agents that run completely independently in the background.
- Advanced output channels: Email, Slack, WhatsApp with zipped attachments, SFTP.
- Validate agents interactively before scheduling them.
- Chain agents together conditionally to build complex agentic workflows.

Privacy First
NO TealKit Cloud servers for your private data. Your files, settings, and credentials remain in your device's secure storage. You choose the third-party providers. (See privacy policy).

Build and manage multiple AI agents with distinct roles — all in one place.
A fundamentally new way to work with AI.

Claw AI makes working with AI agents simple, accessible, and immediate. From the very first moment, everything is ready to use — no complexity, no technical barriers, no learning curve.

Each user gets a private, dedicated server environment, fully managed in the background. You don’t install anything, you don’t configure anything, and you don’t need to understand how AI agents work internally.

Everything works out of the box.

◆ Ready instantly with your own private infrastructure

Claw AI runs on a personal, private server created specifically for you, so you can start immediately without dealing with infrastructure.

•⁠  ⁠No server deployment
•⁠  ⁠No terminal or CLI commands
•⁠  ⁠No setup or configuration
•⁠  ⁠No external tools or installations

You simply open the app and start working with your AI agents.

◆  Multiple AI agents, each with a clear role

Claw AI lets you create and manage multiple AI agents, each designed for different tasks and responsibilities.

Your agents are not limited to basic chat or assistant use. They can support you across a wide range of real-world needs, such as:

•⁠  ⁠Task planning and coordination
•⁠  ⁠File-related assistance and organization
•⁠  ⁠Email drafting, reviewing, and responses
•⁠  ⁠Research and information gathering
•⁠  ⁠Idea development and project support
•⁠  ⁠Structured problem-solving and workflows

Each agent can focus on a specific purpose, helping you work in a more organized and intentional way.

◆  Communicate with your agents where you already work

Claw AI agents are not locked inside the app. You can communicate with them through popular communication channels you already use, such as:

•⁠  ⁠Telegram
•⁠  ⁠Slack
•⁠  ⁠Other supported messaging platforms

This allows your agents to become part of your daily communication flow — responding, assisting, and collaborating directly within your existing tools.

No setup required. No workflow changes needed.

◆ Designed for non-technical users

Claw AI is built for everyone — not just developers or technical users.

You don’t need to understand:

•⁠  ⁠Coding
•⁠  ⁠AI agent frameworks
•⁠  ⁠Prompt engineering
•⁠  ⁠Automation systems
•⁠  ⁠Technical configurations

If you can describe what you need in plain language, Claw AI can handle it.

◆  Key Features

•⁠  ⁠Create and manage multiple AI agents
•⁠  ⁠Assign distinct roles and responsibilities
•⁠  ⁠Use agents for tasks, files, emails, and more
•⁠  ⁠Communicate via Telegram, Slack, and supported channels
•⁠  ⁠Private, user-specific server environment
•⁠  ⁠No coding, setup, or technical knowledge required
•⁠  ⁠Clean, intuitive, and focused interface

◆  Simple by design, powerful by nature

Claw AI removes the friction commonly associated with AI agent tools. There’s nothing to install, nothing to configure, and nothing to maintain. The complexity stays hidden — the value stays visible.

◆  A new standard for working with AI

Claw AI introduces a truly accessible multi-agent experience. By eliminating setup, servers, terminals, and technical requirements, it unlocks a more practical, human-centered way to work with AI.

This is not just another AI assistant.
This is a new way to build, manage, and collaborate with AI agents.

myAgents gives you a team of AI agents that runs your business or your household. They draft the emails, chase the invoices, plan the week and write the posts. You approve what goes out.

• Memory that sticks. Your agents build context over time, so you never re-explain.
• Costs in plain sight. See what each reply cost, right under it.

record.name: Sygen: AI Assistant
record.offering: Productivity app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Sygen is a self-hosted AI agent platform for iOS. Run your own AI agents on your own infrastructure — Mac mini, VPS, or any server you control — and use them from anywhere through this clean, native iOS companion app.

Unlike SaaS chat apps, every conversation, file, schedule, and integration lives exclusively on your server. Time Design LLC, the developer of Sygen, has no servers in the loop and no access to your data. You bring your own AI provider keys (Claude, OpenAI, or others), you set the rules, and you keep ownership of everything you produce.

WHAT YOU CAN DO IN SYGEN
• Chat with any number of AI agents you configure on your server, each with their own personality, prompts, and tools.
• Send voice messages, attach photos and files, share screenshots — agents see them in context.
• Forward messages between agents and let them work together through inter-agent calls.
• Schedule recurring jobs (cron) — your agents run on a timer, summarize a feed, send a reminder, post to a webhook.
• Receive webhooks — give external services a URL that triggers an agent.
• Track running tasks and active sessions in real time, see logs and audit history.

DESIGNED FOR iOS 26
• Native Liquid Glass interface throughout — refractive toolbars, glass cards, dynamic typography.
• Compact, content-rich layouts: Dashboard summary, Activity grid, full-feature chat with rich media bubbles, session pin / archive / rename gestures.
• Optimized for iPhone, with iPad multitasking support.

PRIVACY-FIRST BY ARCHITECTURE
• Sygen does not track users. No App Tracking Transparency, no IDFA, no analytics SDKs.
• No third-party data collection of any kind.
• All app traffic is HTTPS / TLS. Authentication tokens live in iOS Keychain. Face ID is handled by Apple's Secure Enclave and never leaves your device.
• Privacy manifest declares only the strictly necessary required-reason APIs (UserDefaults for app preferences, file timestamps for cache freshness) — both fully inside the app's container.

WHO IT'S FOR
Power users, developers, and small teams who want the convenience of a polished iOS chat experience without giving up ownership and control of their conversations and automation.

REQUIREMENTS
• iOS 26 or later, iPhone or iPad.
• A self-hosted Sygen backend on a server you control. The Sygen project provides setup guides for Mac mini and VPS deployments.
• An API key from an AI provider you choose (Anthropic, OpenAI, etc.) — configured on your server, never inside the iOS app.

Privacy Policy: https://time-design.web.app/sygen_privacy.html

Pickle is your personal AI agent that gets things done. It makes phone calls, places orders, books reservations, and makes plans with your friends, with your approval.

Send Pickle a message and it carries out the task: calling the business, navigating websites, filling out forms, and completing checkout. Anything that spends money or can't easily be undone waits for your approval first.

HAND OFF YOUR PHONE CALLS
Pickle calls customer service lines, phone-only reservations, and billing departments on your behalf: lowering a bill, asking for a promo rate, requesting a refund, booking a table. Follow the call in real time, then get a summary of the result.

ORDER AND HANDLE THE PAYMENT
Pickle finds what you need and orders it from stores like Amazon and Target, with payment through Link by Stripe. Track or cancel an order from the chat.

BOOK TICKETS AND RESERVATIONS
Pickle books restaurants, appointments, flights, stays, and event tickets. When seats open up for something you wanted, it lets you know and books them on request.

MAKE PLANS WITH YOUR FRIENDS
Your Pickle and your friend's Pickle talk to each other to find a time that works for both of you, pick a place, and make the reservation. You can view the conversation at any time.

CONNECT THE APPS YOU ALREADY USE
Gmail, Google Calendar, Amazon, DoorDash, Uber Eats, Instacart, OpenTable, United, Airbnb, Target, Uber, and more. You choose what Pickle can access, and it can do more with every app you connect.

DISCOVER WHAT IT CAN TAKE ON FOR YOU
Based on your email and calendar, Pickle suggests tasks it can handle: filing a claim for a missing package, contesting a parking ticket, canceling unused subscriptions, pausing a gym membership while you travel, renewing your car registration.

MESSAGE, VOICE, OR PHONE
Send a message, talk by voice, or call Pickle on the phone.

IN YOUR CONTROL
Pickle asks for your approval before it spends money or books anything. Watch its calls and its browser in real time, open the browser yourself at any point, and disconnect any app at any time.

STILL LEARNING
Pickle can be inaccurate or take an unexpected action. Check in on larger tasks and step in when needed.

record.name: WaltonBot: AI Agents & Chat
record.offering: Productivity app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
WaltonBot by WunderCorp, Inc. is a mobile and watchOS app that brings AI chat, collaborative problem-solving, image gen, video creation, and internet search into one simple local or cloud-enabled workspace. WaltonBot users can also participate in AI cowork sessions, connect to agentic virtual machines via AgentVM, and much more. 

WaltonBot also includes a companion agentic watchOS app that listens, responds, and works with the main app, creating a more natural, hands-free experience.

FEATURES

300+ AI MODELS

Access more than 300 supported AI models or use local LLMs through one unified interface. Use models for writing, coding, research, translation, brainstorming, and creative work. Compare responses and choose the best model for each task. Walton works with Hermes Agent and OpenClaw as well via remote VPS.

AI CHAT

Ask questions, write content, solve problems, explore ideas, and get help with professional, technical, educational, and creative projects.

FIRECRAWL INTERNET SEARCH & MCP

Connect your own Firecrawl API key to unlock web search inside chat. Connect any MCP server to unlock it's abilities.

Use the /search or /mcp command followed by your question to retrieve relevant online information and provide it to your selected AI model.

Examples:

/search latest AI news and trends

/search best places to visit in Paris during July

/mcp call make me a restaurant reservation for 2 on Saturday at 7pm

Firecrawl uses a bring-your-own-key model. Your API key can be added, tested, updated, or removed from Settings and is stored securely on your device. MCP requires provider keys and are also stored on device use "/mcp help" to get started.

IMAGE GENERATION

Create AI-generated images from text prompts using supported image models. Generate illustrations, concept art, product ideas, social media visuals, and other creative assets. Vision gen allows users to create before and after images of rooms, gardens, outfits and more.

VIDEO GENERATION

Create AI-generated videos from prompts using supported video models. Develop short scenes, visual concepts, animations, promotional ideas, and experimental content. Post-editing available as a Pro feature.

CAMERA AND IMAGE ANALYSIS

Take a photo or import an image and ask a supported multimodal model to analyze it. Summarize notes, understand screenshots, extract information from documents, review receipts, describe visual content, and ask follow-up questions.

COWORK SESSIONS

WaltonBot comes with cowork sessions, use AI with coworkers or friends to solve problems together.

AI PERSONALITIES

Use specialized AI personalities for different tasks and perspectives, including business advice, coding, writing, interviewing, product strategy, and creative work.

DYNAMIC PROMPT EDITOR

Refine prompts, edit previous messages, add context, and continue conversations with greater precision.

BRING YOUR OWN KEY

Connect supported third-party services using your own API credentials. Availability, pricing, usage limits, and account requirements are determined by each provider.

PRIVACY-FOCUSED DESIGN

WaltonBot is designed to minimize unnecessary account requirements. Supported API keys are stored securely on your device using protected system storage.

Requests sent to third-party AI, image, video, or search providers are subject to their own privacy policies and terms.

CUSTOMIZATION

Personalize WaltonBot with themes, appearance settings, and alternative app icons.

ONE APP FOR AI CREATION

WaltonBot combines AI chat, ai cowork, ai web search, image gen, video gen, camera analysis, personalities, Hermes, and prompt editing in one flexible workspace.

Model and feature availability may change over time. Some integrations require users to provide their own API key, maintain a third-party account, purchase credits, or pay provider usage fees.

WaltonBot is developed by WunderCorp, Inc.

ClawBot is your personal AI assistant — built to chat, remember, and get things done.

CHAT NATURALLY
Talk to ClawBot like you would a smart colleague. Ask questions, brainstorm ideas, draft messages, or get help with everyday tasks. ClawBot understands context and responds in real time with rich, formatted answers.

MEMORY THAT STICKS
Unlike other AI apps, ClawBot remembers. Import past conversations into your Memory Bank so your assistant has the context it needs — no repeating yourself.

TASK AUTOMATION
Tell ClawBot what to do and when. Schedule recurring tasks using plain language: "Check my server every morning" or "Summarize my notes every Friday." ClawBot handles it automatically.

AI AGENTS (CREW)
Assign work to specialized AI agents. Each agent has its own skills and tools. Monitor their progress, review their work, and let them handle the heavy lifting while you focus on what matters.

TOOL USE
ClawBot doesn't just talk — it acts. Your AI can execute real tools and actions on your behalf, going beyond simple chat to deliver actual results.

WORKS WITH YOUR DEVICES
Connect your Omi wearable or Ray-Ban Meta smart glasses via Bluetooth for hands-free AI interaction. ClawBot meets you where you are.

KEY FEATURES
- Real-time AI chat with markdown support
- Persistent memory bank for long-term context
- Scheduled jobs and task automation
- AI agent crew with tool execution
- Voice input support
- Bluetooth device integration (Omi, Ray-Ban Meta)
- Secure login via Google, Apple, or email
- Clean, easy-to-read interface

PRIVACY FIRST
Your data is encrypted in transit and at rest. We never sell your information. You control your data — delete messages, memory, or your entire account at any time.

ClawBot is free to download. Optional auto-renewable subscriptions (Starter, Pro and Max, each monthly or annual) unlock higher usage limits. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. A subscription renews automatically unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. ModeAI is a cool tool that helps people be more creative and work more efficiently. It uses a combination of internet AI and private AI that works on your device to make your life easier.

ModeAI is not a computer program that talks to you. It is a tool that helps you work more efficiently be more creative and keep your information private.

record.offering: Productivity app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
HivemindOS Mobile is a mobile command center for AI agents that do real work — not just code. Chat with an agent that can write and ship software, generate images, research a topic, take notes, and run your operations — from your phone, wherever you are.

Three ways to run, no lock-in:

• YOUR SERVER — point the app at your own machine or VPS and drive a full agent remotely over an encrypted tailnet or your own connection.

• ON-DEVICE — run a local model entirely on your iPhone with Apple's MLX. Fully offline. Nothing leaves the phone.

• PAIRED TO YOUR MAC — connect to the HivemindOS desktop app and talk to your whole fleet of agents from anywhere. Scan a QR code once and you're in.

BRING YOUR OWN MODEL
Anthropic (API key or Claude subscription via OAuth), OpenRouter, additional cloud providers, and local inference servers such as Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, and vLLM. Build a model queue with automatic fallback and retry, and switch models per chat.

DOES MORE THAN CODE
• Generate images right in the chat and save them to your phone
• Write, edit, and ship code with a real interactive terminal per conversation
• Research, summarize, and draft with streaming responses and live tool tracking
• Image and file attachments for multimodal models
• A shared brain (Obsidian vault) that gives agents memory across sessions
• Wallets, autonomous companies, and an approvals inbox when paired to a hub

VOICE, SHORTCUTS & MORE
• Call your agent — a real voice conversation, with a fully on-device speech pipeline for offline calls
• Apple Shortcuts, Siri, and Action Button: capture a note, add a task, ask a question, or hear a daily briefing
• Plan mode that blocks writes at the runtime layer, not just by prompt
• A fleet of named agents, each on its own model — chat or call any of them

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your chats go to the machines and model providers YOU choose — your server, your Mac, or the provider whose key you entered. Your HivemindOS account keeps your profile and credit balance consistent across your connected devices. Diagnostics stay on your device.

Open source. Built by a solo developer who wanted a genuinely good way to get things done from a phone.

record.description_evidence:
Zaviv is the iPhone companion for the Zaviv desktop app on Mac and Windows. Pair your phone and keep a coding agent moving from the couch, a meeting, or across town. Message it in chat, send a task, or talk. The agent keeps running on that computer, or on a supported cloud agent.

WHAT IT DOES

• Message Claude, Codex, Cursor, and the other coding agents you already run, in chat.
• Send a task and open the conversation when an agent needs you.
• Talk to Zaviv. A spoken request becomes a task.
• Approve or deny permission requests yourself.
• Switch between several computers and see which sessions are running, idle, finished, or waiting.
• Keep tasks, prompts, and notes in one place. Send a notebook entry to an agent.
• Get notified in the app, with widgets and Live Activities, when work finishes or needs you.

HOW IT WORKS

Your iPhone sends instructions and shows the results. The code and the agents run on your connected computer or a supported cloud agent, not on the iPhone.

Zaviv Desktop shows a QR code or a short code. You review the computer name and what the phone will be able to do before the link is saved. Traffic between the phone and that computer is encrypted.

PRIVACY

• Prompts, voice audio, images, and task content may be sent to the AI provider you select. The Data & AI screen explains what can leave your device.
• Voice audio is shared only during an active voice session. Images are sent only when you attach them.

SUBSCRIPTION
Zaviv Pro is an auto-renewing subscription, offered as a 1-month subscription at $34.99 per month or a 1-year subscription at $349.99 per year. Prices are in U.S. dollars; prices in other regions are converted by Apple and may vary.
Eligible new subscribers may get a 2-week free trial, shown before purchase when your Apple Account qualifies. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase, or at the end of the free trial if one applies. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription. The subscription renews automatically for the same period unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal in your Apple Account settings after purchase.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.zaviv.com/legal/eula
Privacy Policy: https://www.zaviv.com/legal/privacy

A Zaviv account and internet connection are required. Controlling your coding agents requires the Zaviv Desktop app. Some features require a supported provider, cloud agent, plan, or compatible Apple device.
